parsed.note_claim: US 2025 strikes obliterated Iran's nuclear facilities at Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan, per White House.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Initial battle damage assessments indicate that all three sites sustained extremely severe damage and destruction.
parsed.reason: The White House release directly confirms that US strikes severely damaged and destroyed Iran's nuclear facilities, with multiple officials quoted confirming obliteration of Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan.
